title: From General Learning Ability to Uncertainty Monitoring in Honey Bees
summary: A completed quantitative synthesis and theory paper showing reproducible covariance among honey-bee learning tasks while separating that evidence from uncertainty-monitoring, metacognition, and consciousness claims; it formalizes competing models and specifies the same-individual experiment needed to connect the literatures.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C full reconstruction; finalized as quantitative synthesis + theory article
